lines.text: [curious, a little playful] Got an issue you never get to? [confident] Paste it into Yarrow.
[warm, relaxed] Minutes later, it's in your dashboard... ready to be reviewed, and ONE click from merged.
[proud] And every pull request carries the card of the sponsor who paid for it.
[smiling] That's why it's free. Sponsors fund the compute... and show up on every PR they pay for.
[confident, warm] Yarrow. Free pull requests from frontier AI.
